items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs Rams; resting for long-term healing.
items.why: Ankle injury; HC confirmed rest for long-term.
items.implication: ARI RB depth thins; monitor backups for any expanded role.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining ARI RBs if any volume opens.

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) for Sunday at Cleveland; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and red-zone efficiency drop.
items.opportunity: Slight bump to Ravens RBs/WRs in volume if game script shifts, but overall offense downgrade.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs Patriots.
items.implication: Braelon Allen handles primary RB load again.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry share for Jets backup RBs; handcuff elevation.

items.text: Jalen Hurts ruled out Week 6 (superficial blood clot); Berry likes Tanner McKee as fill-in starter.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles total down, check Barkley/Smith status too.
items.opportunity: McKee streamer upside in decent spot; Saquon/Devonta if healthy get volume.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially questionable after full practices; stacking sessions key for clearance vs Falcons.
items.why: Hamstring; full practice but response to multiple days monitored.
items.implication: Likely plays but monitor final; Bears offense hinges on it.
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup QB and pass-catchers (Odunze etc) impacted; if IN, upgrade.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (high-ankle) practiced, feels pretty good; Berry notes NE plays TNF next so may be testing availability more for following week.
items.why: High-ankle sprain but surprised he practiced; feels good.
items.implication: Possible limited role or rest; Rhamondre primary.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, Stevenson full workload; if IN limited, still secondary.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) out Sunday vs Chargers per HC Andy Reid.
items.implication: Xavier Worthy/others see target bump in KC.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Worthy, Kelce, remaining WRs.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee), RB David Montgomery (groin), S Jalen Pitre out; will not travel to London vs Jags.
items.implication: Woody Marks or other HOU RBs elevated for London game.
items.opportunity: Full RB1 workload for Marks/handcuffs; Dell absence opens WR targets.

items.text: Berry LOVES Mike Evans as WR4 vs Commanders secondary; soft matchup for pass catchers.
items.why: Washington D is buffet for pass catchers; Evans WR4 rank.
items.implication: Strong start/sit upgrade in tough WR week.
items.opportunity: High target share expected vs weak secondary.

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London vs CHI (WR6); bankable usage in solid spot.
items.why: Usage you can bank on; soft-ish matchup themes.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
items.why: Volume elite lately; ARI run D leaks.

items.text: Berry LOVES George Kittle (TE3) and Brock Purdy (QB2) vs WSH; Commanders D vulnerable to pass.
items.why: WSH defense nightmare for TE/QB spots; high-scoring potential.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Kittle; Purdy efficiency boost.

items.text: Levitan notes Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb etc); Saquon turns 30 in Feb—if contender needs RB, call now.
items.why: Age/trade-early precedent; better move year early than late.
items.implication: Long-term ROS caution or trade signal for contenders; short-term hamstring monitor.
items.opportunity: If traded or reduced, backups rise; currently DNP hamstring.
items.conflict: Short-term usage still elite if healthy.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28); tough matchup and recent form.
items.why: Seattle tough for WRs; shaky efficiency.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats despite volume.
items.conflict: Waddle returned from Q shoulder in TNF but still faded weekly.
